meta.description: A stripe pattern on a disc that grows outward ring by ring, like gills under a cap: where the circumference grows, stripes fork and new ones start between them, so they stay about spacing apart.

radius.description: Outer radius of the disc, the pattern reaches this far from the axis

inner_radius.description: Where the pattern starts, the stripes there are evenly spaced

alignment.description: 0 = winding stripes that fork and join often, 1 = straight stripes running outward

irregularity.description: 0 = evenly spaced stripes that all fork at the same radius, 1 = uneven stripes that fork and start one by one

steps.description: How long the pattern settles at every ring as the disc grows. More steps are smoother and slower.
